Onboarding.title: Organization setup
Onboarding.bannerHelp: Complete and review organization facts before generating your compliance plan.
Onboarding.noTemplates: No published templates are available. Setup can be completed; the compliance plan will remain empty until your platform publishes templates.
Onboarding.reviewRequired: Some templates require more facts. Review their explanations and update the profile before completion.
Onboarding.deadlineRequired: An applicable template needs event or certificate deadline facts before generation. Save your progress and add those facts.
Onboarding.empty: No records yet. Optional sections can be completed later.
Onboarding.error: Unable to save setup. Your entered information is preserved. Please retry.
Onboarding.help: Optional facts may remain undeclared. The rule engine will show Requires Review if a published template needs them.
Onboarding.reviewHelp: Review every section. Setup completeness is separate from legal compliance health.
Onboarding.name: Name
Onboarding.loginHelp: A login invitation grants workspace access only after the recipient accepts it. Responsibility roles are assigned separately.
Onboarding.responsibilityHelp: This creates a responsibility record. It does not create a login account or grant workspace access.
Onboarding.readOnly: Ask a workspace administrator to complete organization setup.
Onboarding.noOriginal: Document records are shown here. Private file storage is delivered in Phase 4.
Onboarding.taxMasked: Tax identifiers are masked on this review. View the organization profile to verify them.
